final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amt FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), s2 AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_amt) AS avg2 FROM s1 GROUP BY region), s3 AS (SELECT AVG(avg2) AS avg3 FROM s2), s4 AS (SELECT s2.region AS region, s2.avg2 AS avg2, s2.avg2 - s3.avg3 AS diff FROM s2 JOIN s3 ON s3.avg3 IS NOT NULL WHERE s2.avg2 > s3.avg3), s5 AS (SELECT AVG(avg2) AS avg5 FROM s2) SELECT s4.region, s4.avg2, s4.diff, s4.avg2 * 1.0 / NULLIF(s5.avg5, 0) AS ratio FROM s4 JOIN s5 ON s5.avg5 IS NOT NULL
